data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'fza', meaning 'to give' or 'to bestow'. In Islamic context, Ifza represents a blessing or gift from Allah. The name Ifza carries the meaning “Gift, Blessing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ifza usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, blessing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
